label: Act: InAct x r: x actually has the perfection r, as fire is actually hot
definition: `InAct x r`: x actually has the perfection r, as fire is actually hot. In Lean `InAct` is a parameter, not a definition: its content is fixed only by the premises that use it, above all that nothing is in act and in potency in the same respect at once. Whether a mover must have the perfection formally or may have it virtually is left open (DISAMB-IN-ACT).
note: Lean locator: MotionModel.InAct is the field InAct : Being → Respect → Prop, not the whole MotionModel and not a proof of its metaphysical interpretation. The field is a primitive input; the linked premise readings constrain its use but do not define actual possession of a perfection. The match between an intended example and this primitive interpretation remains OPEN.

formal_gap.meaning: MotionModel.InAct x r says that the being x actually has the perfection or determination r now, as fire is actually hot. It is a supplied relation between a being and a respect. At the distinguished respect esse it says that x has being (DEF-ESSE). Lean does not fix whether 'actually having r' means having it formally (as r itself) or virtually (as able to cause it): DISAMB-IN-ACT records both senses and the case does not choose.
examples: Fire actually hot, with r being hot.
A knower actually contemplating, with r contemplating.
exclusions: Being only able to be r: potency (DEF-POTENCY, InPotency x r := CanBe x r ∧ ¬ InAct x r in the adopted sense).
Having had r in the past, or being going to have it.

The formal, virtual and inclusive act senses of ActFrame (DEF-IN-ACT-FORMALLY, DEF-IN-ACT-VIRTUALLY, DEF-IN-ACT-FORMALLY-OR-VIRTUALLY) are separate declarations; this field is not identified with any one of them.
open_obligations: That nothing is in act and in potency in the same respect at once is the premise STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT, not a law of the field. For the adopted potency predicate (DEF-POTENCY, defined from CanBe and InAct) it holds by construction; MotionModel.InPotency is a separate field, so in a MotionModel it remains a premise.
That a mover is in act in the respect in which it moves is the separate premise STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-EXCEPT-AS-IN-ACT.
Which of the formal and virtual senses a defence of the act premises uses must be fixed and defended for all of them (DISAMB-IN-ACT); this remains OPEN.
No formalization candidate: actual possession of a perfection is the basic notion from which potency is defined, not defined from other vocabulary.
